title: Registration diagnostics fields() drops correlation fields when lock timings are unavailable
outcome: Registration diagnostics fields() drops correlation fields when lock timings are unavailable
acceptance: When lock_timings is unavailable (busy or poisoned), the registration diagnostic marks only the wait/hold/locks timing fields UNKNOWN and still includes runId, operationId, attemptId, category, httpStatus, phase and requestDigest in both the console line and the error text.
A regression covers the unavailable-timings path, and the review pair finds no Medium or higher.
